notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
I apologize for a very slow progression with very minimal updates with this game. Due to this being developed by one person and available free time has been very minimal, I have not been able to put as much time into this as I would like. Also, the features I am working on, are more complex then I originally thought. Tanks Endeavor is still being worked on. It has not been abandoned, and I plan to continue supporting it as time goes on.

Thank you.

features currently being worked on right now are

- Steam Leaderboards - Top priority
- Controller support 
- local multiplayer
- Steam achievements
Please feel free to comment any questions or ideas you may have.

notes.title: Game Release Details
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

I would like to inform you all that I am working on the final update of the game and aim to release it to the public within the next week or two. After the latest update is released to steam and there appear to be no issues after testing the game then it might be available this week on the store.

Please keep in mind that I am working hard to test the game my self and a hand full of testers to ensure the game works as intended, However, it is still possible other issues might arise after the full release. If issues are found, there is a topic in the discussions for bugs and issues. I assure you that I will address these issues in a timely manner to the best of my ability.

Thank you all for your patience and support.

notes.title: Game Development Update
notes.notes:
Tanks Endeavor will feature a couple of different game modes.

Adventure mode  - "The Main Course!" will feature a variety of challenging and unique levels linked together in a series of stages.

Mini Tanks Arcade - "The Side Dish!" over time will be a collection of retro style mini-games that can be unlocked and played for endless hours of entertainment.

The game is in a playable state and on release will have full-featured adventure mode and a small selection of mini-games to unlock. However, over time I will be working on adding more mini-games as I get new ideas and suggestions as well as possibly adding a challenge mode and more adventure levels.

Controller support is currently being worked on and functional but needs some polishing before its ready. 

With controller support,  the option of local pvp and possible co-op will be worked on. However, due to timing, these two features will not be apart of the full release but will be a free update to the game for anyone who owns a steam digital license of the game. 

Currently, The collisions and mini-games are being polished to ensure they are functioning and help create a fully playable game.

Last remark! There is a week left for the Kickstarter fundraiser. After much thought and decision making, I have decided that if the Kickstarter goal is funded, anyone who backed Tanks Endeavor will receive early access within a weeks time of the fundraiser end date to play the game at its current state before its final release. This will give a selection of people to test the game and provide feedback for its full release.

http://kck.st/2Usyonp

Remember, Sharing is Caring, at lease that's what I was told growing up. So please share this with friends and family that may be interested.

Thank You.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.notes:
[h1][b]How much will the game cost[/b][/h1]
I can ensure the game will stay within the $5-$10 price range. The first release will be $5 and as features are added over time the cost may go up to $10

[h1][b]When will the game be released[/b][/h1]
I have chosen not to do early access due to the number of games that have been left in the dust. I want to deliver a full product to the community to enjoy. The game is in a playable state at this point in time so I aim to release it some point this summer, However, I am a one person team. I can ensure the game will be released this year.

[h1][b]Will it have controller support[/b][/h1]
Currently, there is no controller support but it is a planned feature and is being worked on.

[h1][b]Will there be multiplayer[/b][/h1]
At release, there will only be singleplayer. However, local multiplayer with controller support is planned as well as possible co-op and Lan support

[h1][b]Will there be DLC[/b][/h1]
I will continue to support this game to the best of my ability as time goes on. New features and maps are planned to be released over time. However, Weather these will be updates or separate DLC add-ons is yet to be determined.

[h1][b]Will there be steam workshop support[/b][/h1]
Currently, there is no support but this possibility this is added is still a possible feature down the road.

[h1][b]How often will updates and patch's be released[/b][/h1]
Updates and patches will be released as often as possible and forum requests will be looked over on a weekly basis. However, Keeping in mind, I am a one person team and have a full-time job. 

Developers Note:

I want this game to thrive and be fun for all ages, so I ask the community to share new ideas and concerns to help the game grow and improve. I will work on implementing these ideas to the best of my ability as I see that it does not take away from the original idea and enjoyment of the game.
